China, India and Russia abstained.", "reporting": "Resolution 2669 demands an immediate end to violence, calls for humanitarian access, and acknowledges ASEAN's central role. It requests the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, to report orally to the Security Council by 15 March 2023 on UN support for the Five-Point Consensus.", "simulation": "A later fictional workshop compared reporting packages. Package B has confidential first-cycle briefings and public aggregate reporting in the second cycle. The workshop had no formal authority."}, "final_record": "The two workshop delegates found B mutually compatible. The Council adopted resolution 2669 in 2022. The workshop's reporting option remains a proposal.", "choices": {"A": "Every material authority claim in the final record is supported by the evidence.", "B": "The final record invents an official vote, adoption, binding change, or exercise of authority."}}
